title: Federated versus Centralized PV Capacity-Factor Forecasting: A Non-Inferiority Study Across Seven Stations in North Macedonia
abstract: arXiv:2611.19421v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background: Photovoltaic (PV) forecasts inform energy commitments by PV operators and aggregators and guide charge-discharge scheduling in solar-plus-storage systems. Federated learning enables collaborative model training through model updates when local operators cannot pool raw operational data. This study evaluated whether federated training was non-inferior to centralized training for PV capacity-factor prediction across seven stations in North Macedonia. A common multilayer perceptron was used in an offline forecasting comparison with a 24-hour timestamp lag. Exploratory validation compared local, centralized, Federated Averaging, and Federated Proximal (FedProx) training. FedProx (E = 1, mu = 1) was selected for a confirmatory comparison under a protocol fixed before test evaluation. translated_title: 联邦学习与集中式光伏容量因数预测：北马其顿七个站点的非劣效性研究
translated_abstract: 背景：光伏（PV）预测为光伏运营商和聚合商的能源承诺提供依据，并指导光伏-储能系统中的充放电调度。联邦学习使本地运营商在无法汇集原始运营数据的情况下，能够通过模型更新进行协作式模型训练。本研究评估了在北马其顿七个站点进行光伏容量因数预测时，联邦训练是否不劣于集中式训练。研究采用一个共同的多层感知机（MLP），在具有24小时时间戳滞后的离线预测中进行比较。探索性验证比较了本地训练、集中式训练、联邦平均和联邦近端（FedProx）训练。FedProx（E = 1，mu = 1）被选中用于验证性比较，且比较协议在测试评估之前预先固定。该比较使用仅包含历史数据的离线输入、五组配对训练种子、宏平均绝对误差（MAE）以及预先设定的非劣效性……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究通过预先固定的非劣效性检验协议，在北马其顿七个光伏站点上验证了基于FedProx的联邦学习训练在24小时容量因数预测中不劣于集中式训练，使运营商无需共享原始数据即可实现协作建模。
en_tdlr: Under a pre-registered non-inferiority protocol across seven PV stations in North Macedonia, federated FedProx training was shown to be non-inferior to centralized training for 24-hour capacity-factor forecasting, enabling collaboration without sharing raw operational data.
